Vanford F.positioning: Original 2020 lightweight spinning family for freshwater finesse and light inshore lure fishing.
Vanford F.featureSentence: On sizes other than the 500, the MGL Rotor supports quick start-up for lure work and the Long Stroke Spool supports casting and line lay.

Stradic FL.featureSentence: MicroModule Gear II and SilentDrive target smooth retrieves, while the C3000, 4000 and C5000 add Cross Carbon Drag for controlled line release under load.

Ultegra FC.positioning: 2021 midrange spinning family intended for freshwater, brackish and light saltwater use.

Sahara FI.featureSentence: The 1000-C5000 models combine HAGANE Gear and X-Ship with a G-Free Body intended to keep the reel's balance closer to the rod hand during repeated casting.

Sedona FI.positioning: Entry-level spinning family ranging from ultralight freshwater sizes to larger shore and saltwater sizes.
Sedona FI.featureSentence: The Propulsion Line Management spool design supports line release on the cast; HAGANE Gear is fitted above the 500 size, and the 8000 adds Cross Carbon Drag.

Stella FJ.featureSentence: MicroModule Gear II and SilentDrive support a smooth retrieve, while the Long Stroke Spool and tangle-proof rotor address casting and line handling.
